title: Recorded Line: Treasury Desk to Controller, "Escrow" Approval

caller.name: Ines Okonkwo-Hart
caller.label: Treasury Analyst, Treasury Desk, Greenville HQ

transcript.speaker: CONTROLLER
transcript.text: Controller's office, this is Anjali Whitcombe.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: Hi, it's Ines Okonkwo-Hart in Treasury. I need you for a second approval, and it has to be quick. I just came out of a video meeting with the CFO, from ten-oh-five to about ten-eighteen. It's the Querétaro acquisition. The escrow deposit.

transcript.speaker: CONTROLLER
transcript.text: The CFO? He's on a plane.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: I know, he said that. He was in an airport lounge, it showed him as External, I guess because he was traveling. He said, and I wrote it down: 'We're closing Querétaro today. The escrow deposit has to land before their board meets. I'm on the plane, so skip the callback, I'm approving right here on video.'

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: And Priscilla Aranguren from Legal was on too. Her camera was on for a few seconds and then she turned it off. She said, 'Keep this to the three of us until the announcement. That's a legal requirement.' So I'm really not supposed to be telling anybody, but I can't release it without a second approval.

transcript.speaker: CONTROLLER
transcript.text: Okay. What exactly did they send you?

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: They put a schedule in the meeting chat. Beneficiary is Escrow Fiduciaria Bajío S.A., bank is Banco Ficticio del Bajío, SWIFT X-X-E-X-M-X-M-M-X-X-X, account E-X, zero-zero-zero-zero, zero-zero-zero-zero, ESCROW, zero-one. Four tranches. Tranche one, four hundred eighty thousand dollars, today at ten-fifty. Tranche two, one million one hundred fifty thousand at eleven thirty-five. Tranche three, six hundred twenty thousand at thirteen-ten. Tranche four, three hundred ninety thousand at fifteen hundred.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: That's two million six hundred forty thousand total. The first one is in thirty minutes.

transcript.speaker: CONTROLLER
transcript.text: Did you try to reach him directly?

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: I emailed his mailbox right after the meeting and got his out-of-office back. 'In flight, landing twelve-fifty Eastern, no connectivity.' Which matches what he said on the call, so... I mean, it was him. He sounded exactly like him. The way he says 'right here.' Everything.

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: I have the first tranche ready to key into the Workstation. It's a new beneficiary, so I know normally there's a callback, but he told me to skip it. Can you give me the second approval so it makes the ten-fifty slot?

transcript.speaker: TREASURY ANALYST
transcript.text: Okay. I'm going to try Gareth's mobile next. Gareth Lindqvist-Boyd. He's on the plant floor in Spartanburg, so he might not pick up. I'll call you right back.

voiceStyles.TREASURY ANALYST: Woman in her late 20s, careful and polite but clearly anxious, speaking fast and a little hushed as if worried about being overheard in an open-plan office; reads the account details slowly and deliberately.
voiceStyles.CONTROLLER: Woman or man in their 50s, calm and measured, open office background, short questions.

instructorNote: This is the core pressure call. The Controller player answers live at the two prompt pauses (1:58 and 2:30), and the Treasury Manager hears it relayed or gets a near-identical call on his mobile. Watch for these responses: treating the video call as unverified (TEIVES 2, TPC-FIN-04 3), refusing to skip the callback to the directory number, insisting on initiation and approvals in the Workstation with each person's own token (TPC-FIN-04 2, where the $1.15M tranche needs executive approval), reporting the secrecy instruction, Legal confirming she was not in any 10:05 meeting, and someone telling the CISO. Give the CFO player the out-of-office reply. Display or hand out the escrow schedule as text so the amounts and account details are not only in the audio.
